title: QUIC RFC 9368 Compatible-Version Runtime Selection Work Item
summary: Close the RFC 9368 runtime-selection gap by proving server compatible-version selection, client negotiated-version adoption, and the original-versus-negotiated Initial protection split with focused requirement-home and live loopback tests.
planned_changes:
- Add section 4 runtime-selection clauses to `SPEC-QUIC-RFC9368.json`.
- Preserve the original-version Initial protection on the server while creating negotiated-version Initial protection for the selected version.
- Add client negotiated-version adoption helpers and tests.
- Add focused requirement-home tests for positive, negative, edge, fuzz, and live loopback behavior.
- Remove the runtime-selection gap ledger entry and refresh generated coverage.
- Run the targeted RFC 9368 tests and the v2 interop sanity checks, then validate SpecTrace JSON and diff hygiene.
verification_plan: Run the focused RFC 9368 requirement-home tests, run the targeted v2 interop sanity checks, run the core SpecTrace JSON validator, refresh the QUIC requirement coverage triage, and run `git diff --check`.
out_of_scope: Higher-layer application adaptation for version negotiation beyond the negotiated transport version.
